page.layout: One page of text, one column, with the running head at the top right and the page number beside it. The reference marks (Dist., C., Quidam, Quoniam) stand inline at the start of paragraphs within the column. No marginal notes. Signature "I 5" at the foot right.

main_text.p: Dist.28.C.Si quis.) Si quis docuerit sacerdotem sub obtentu religionis propriā uxorem contemnere, anathema sit.

Dist.10.C.Lege.) Beatus Gregorius scribes ad Theotistam patritium, ait inter cætera, Si religionis causa coniugia debere dissolui dicatur, sciendum est, quia etsi hoc lex humana concessit, lex tamen diuina prohibuit.

head.i: Nubentes post votum etiam non esse se parandos. Augusti.in lib.de bono coniugali,

main_text.p: Dist.27.C.Quidam.) Quidam nubentes post votum asserunt adulteros esse, ego autem dico vobis, quòd grauiter peccant qui tales diuidut.
Et paulo ante ex Decreto Martini Papae. Tanta est vis in Sacramento coniugij, quòd nec ex violatione voti potest dissolui ipsum coniugium.
Idem copiose tractatur 27. q. 1. Nuptiarum, & obiectiones refelluntur.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The sentence "Nubentes post votum etiam non esse se parandos" and the word "diuidut" (possibly with a tilde over u) are doubtful. "confite si" at the line break is uncertain: the word may be broken across the line, and the reading "confitentur" was not clearly legible. Headings at level 3 are the italic sentence titles set apart above the passages. The reference marks "Dist.", "C." and "Quidam"/"Quoniam" are printed in the text column and kept inline.
